steps.title: Tuning
steps.text: The tune is the heart of the build. Your tune is custom written for your truck and the parts you choose below. Add transmission tuning here if you want it.

options.name: Colorado / Canyon 2.8L Custom Tuning
options.note: Choose your VIN licence, tune level and transmission tuning.

steps.title: Exhaust
steps.text: Choose the exhaust that goes with your tune. 5 inch moves the most air. A muffler keeps the cab quieter.

steps.title: EGR
steps.text: EGR kit. Optional. Skip it if you don't need it.
